title: erythrococca lasiococca
intro: Erythrococca lasiococca, commonly known as poison nut, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, and has been reported to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Erythrococca lasiococca are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which have been found to contribute to its medicinal properties.
